record.question: Which technology giant acquired Nokia handset business recently?
record.explanation: Answer B: Microsoft. Microsoft acquired substantially all of Nokia's Devices and Services business, completing the transaction on 25 April 2014. Nokia's original stock-exchange release identifies Microsoft as buyer. Historical/source note: Nokia handset/device business transaction, not acquisition of the entire Nokia company. Reference: https://www.nokia.com/newsroom/nokia-completes-sale-of-substantially-all-of-its-devices--services-business-to-microsoft/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
